title: Disposal of electric vehicle batteries
summary: The emergency management administrator said the county has deconstructed 30,000 pounds of electric vehicle batteries for disposal and is setting up an end-of-life program. Earlier, a member raised loose EV batteries left by the road, and an official said Maui is leading in neutralizing batteries.
